hypotheses.statement: Merchants in help-me-choose categories find a catalog fix in the phrases shoppers asked the assistant within 60 days.
hypotheses.pass: 3 or more fixes per founding store in 60 days
hypotheses.fail: Fewer than 1 fix per store: pillar 2 is not landing, revisit the value proposition

hypotheses.statement: A listing that leads with the Shopper Words Test converts at least 3% of listing visits to installs before any review exists.
hypotheses.pass: 3% or more at day 30 after the listing is live
hypotheses.fail: Below 2% at day 30: rework the listing (D42 tripwire)

hypotheses.statement: The four-step checklist gets 65% of installs to widget seen within 24 hours, despite app embeds being off by default.
hypotheses.fail: Below target after 50 installs: tune the checklist prompts and route installs to implementers

hypotheses.statement: A visible, capped quota with a pause instead of overage keeps billing out of the top uninstall reasons.
hypotheses.pass: Pauses cause 20% or less of uninstall reasons
hypotheses.fail: Pauses cause more than 20% of uninstall reasons (D25 tripwire)

hypotheses.statement: 15% of installs reach a paid plan by day 30.
hypotheses.pass: 15% or more at the day 60 review
hypotheses.fail: Below target at day 60: revisit the trial-to-paid sequence and the Free quota

hypotheses.statement: Monthly uninstalls stay under 15% of active installs.
hypotheses.fail: 15% or more for two months running

hypotheses.statement: An offer of paid work gets a 5% reply rate from US implementers on cold email, above the 3.43% average.
hypotheses.fail: Below target at day 30: shift sessions to the channel with the best completion rate (D37)

hypotheses.statement: Implementers complete a paid session with median setup under 30 minutes.
hypotheses.fail: 30 minutes or more: fix the setup path before the next batch

hypotheses.statement: An Upwork post at $150 draws 10 qualified applicants.
hypotheses.fail: Fewer than 10: raise the fee to $200 (D33 tripwire)

hypotheses.statement: Half of session participants join the partner program within 90 days.
hypotheses.fail: Below target: revisit the terms and the invitation route

hypotheses.statement: Paid sessions produce case studies that both the merchant and the implementer permit.
hypotheses.fail: None by day 90: rework the permission ask and the client handoff

hypotheses.statement: Implementers who finish a session put Pico on a second client store.
hypotheses.fail: Below target: the multi-store workspace or the share is not enough

hypotheses.statement: At least half of session participants accept the $75 interview.
hypotheses.fail: Below half: rethink the interview incentive (D34 tripwire)
